Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: TROPICAL CYCLONE "PAOLO"
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Pampanga, Zambales and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Rizal, Laguna, Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balayan, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Calaca, Calatagan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lian, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Nasugbu, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Tuy) and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Bulacan and Metro Manila(Navotas, Malabon, Valenzuela, Caloocan, Manila) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

data.raw_text:
‘DI KUKURAP SA KORAP’ 

Hiphop United Against Corruption, a coalition of HipHop artists and artists’ collectives, holds a benefit event for the persons arrested during the September 21 anti-corruption protest in Mendiola. 

The event held at MEJO Kitchen & Bar in Quezon City on October 3 is also the official launch of the group. Hiphop United Against Corruption was formed as a response to the massive government corruption exposed in the flood control projects probe. The group states in its unity statement that HipHop is a ‘political movement that has historically fought against oppression, racism, and police and state violence against the people.’ They also denounce the statements made by state officials against HipHop groups, saying that it was them who stoked the violence that took place in Mendiola. Instead of recognizing the legitimate calls of the poor, Hiphop artists say, the government chooses to turn a blind eye. 

Hiphop United Against Corruption is calling on other HipHop artists to join their coalition and fight prevailing issues of government corruption.
